title: Correctness of the translated head move
statement: For every integer $z$ and move direction $d\in\{-1,0,+1\}$, let $\varphi(z)=z$ if $z\ge 0$ and $\varphi(z)=-z-1$ otherwise, and let $\sigma(z)$ record whether $z\ge 0$. Translating $d$ using side $\sigma(z)$ and origin flag indicating whether $\varphi(z)=0$ gives a physical displacement and a new side such that adding the displacement to $\varphi(z)$ gives $\varphi(z+d)$, and the new side is $\sigma(z+d)$.
replaced:
Let $z$ be an integer and $d \in \{-1,0,+1\}$ a move direction; write $\varphi(z)$
for the folded coordinate ($z$ when $z \ge 0$, else $-z-1$) and $\sigma(z)$ for the
side of $z$ (whether $z \ge 0$).  Then the translated move computed from $\sigma(z)$,
the flag ``$\varphi(z) = 0$'', and $d$ is correct in both components: adding its
physical displacement to $\varphi(z)$ gives $\varphi(z+d)$, and its returned side
equals $\sigma(z+d)$.
